================================================================================
       FabricTag - Smart Fabric Swatch & Hanger AI System (v4.1.0)
================================================================================

1. QUICK START:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Double-click "Setup_Wizard.bat" to choose your language, set backup folder, 
  and automatically create the FabricTag desktop shortcut.
- Or double-click "Start_FabricTag.bat" to start the app immediately.
- Browser will open automatically at http://127.0.0.1:8000

2. GOOGLE GEMINI AI API SETUP:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- To enable AI swatch card scanning:
  1. Get your free API key at: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey
  2. Go to "Settings & Design" tab, paste your key, and click "Save".
  3. Status will turn green: "Gemini API Active".

3. MOBILE WIRELESS QR CONNECT:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Scan the QR code in the sidebar with your smartphone camera to capture 
  fabric swatches from any phone on the same Wi-Fi network.

4. AUTOMATIC BACKUPS & CLOUD SYNC:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- All database and Excel exports are saved to your configured backup directory.
- You can change the backup folder at any time from "Settings & Design".
================================================================================
